FinancialStatement.title: Financial Statement
FinancialStatement.description: A set of statutory annual accounts (jaarrekening / Jahresabschluss / comptes annuels) for one reporting period, used by the national-reporting rule domain to evaluate statement-layout, composition, size-classification, audit-duty and filing-deadline obligations (NL BW 2 Titel 9, DE HGB, FR PCG/greffe, EU ESEF iXBRL). Per ADR-022 this is a register object, not an embedded structure.

statementType.description: The kind of statutory accounts modelled. One of: annual (full annual accounts), abridged (verkort/abridged), consolidated (geconsolideerd/Konzern), interim.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 jurisdiction whose statutory framework governs these accounts (NL, DE, FR, ...). EU-wide rules (ESEF) apply on top for EU member states.

framework.description: Reporting framework applied (e.g. bw for NL Titel 9, hgb for DE, pcg for FR, ifrs).

reportingPeriodStart.description: First day of the reporting period (financial year).

reportingPeriodEnd.description: Last day of the reporting period (balance-sheet date / financial year-end).

language.description: ISO 639-1 language the accounts are drawn up in (nl, de, fr, en). NL BW 2:362(6) requires Dutch unless justified; DE HGB 244 requires German.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the accounts are presented in. NL BW 2:362(6) and DE HGB 244 require EUR unless justified.

balanceTotal.description: Balance-sheet total (total assets) for the period, used for size classification thresholds.

turnover.description: Net turnover (revenue) for the period, used for size classification thresholds.

employees.description: Average number of employees during the period, used for size classification thresholds.

sizeClass.description: Declared size class. One of: micro, small, medium, large. Must be consistent with the balanceTotal/turnover/employees thresholds of the jurisdiction.

sizeClassPriorYear.description: Size class established on the prior balance-sheet date. A different regime may only be applied after two consecutive balance dates meet it (NL BW 2:398; DE HGB 267(4)).

balanceSheet.description: Statutory balance-sheet layout: assets split into fixed (vaste activa / Anlagevermögen) and current (vlottende activa / Umlaufvermögen) assets; credit side into equity, provisions and liabilities (NL BW 2:364; DE HGB 266).

profitAndLoss.description: Statutory profit-and-loss layout showing net turnover, operating expenses, financial result and the result for the period (NL BW 2:377; DE HGB 275).

financialResult.description: Financial income and expense (financiële baten en lasten).

result.description: Result for the financial year (resultaat / Jahresüberschuss).

plPresentationModel.description: Statutory P&L model. One of: categorical (type-of-expense / Gesamtkostenverfahren) or functional (cost-of-sales / Umsatzkostenverfahren).

balanceForm.description: DE HGB 266 balance presentation form. Account form (Kontoform) is required for the balance sheet.

plForm.description: DE HGB 275 P&L presentation form. Vertical/staggered form (Staffelform) is required.

priorYearComparatives.description: True when each balance-sheet and P&L item is shown with its corresponding prior-year comparative figure (NL BW 2:363).

itemsNetted.description: True when items have been offset/netted against each other. The gross principle forbids netting unless permitted (NL BW 2:363 / DE HGB 246 Saldierungsverbot) — compliant statements set this false.

components.description: The component primary statements present. Codes: balance (balans/Bilanz), pnl (winst-en-verliesrekening/GuV), notes (toelichting/Anhang), cashflow, equityChanges, managementReport (bestuursverslag/Lagebericht).

audited.description: True when the accounts have been audited by an external statutory auditor who issued an opinion (NL BW 2:393; DE HGB 316; FR commissaire aux comptes).

auditorType.description: Registered auditor qualification (RA, AA, Wirtschaftsprüfer, CAC) where audited.

preparedDate.description: Date management prepared (drew up) the accounts. NL BW 2:210 requires preparation within 5 months of year-end (extendable).

adoptionDate.description: Date the accounts were adopted/approved by the general meeting.

filedDate.description: Date the accounts were filed/disclosed with the registry (NL KvK, DE Unternehmensregister, FR greffe).

xhtmlFormat.description: True when the annual financial report is prepared in XHTML format (EU ESEF). Required only for issuers on an EU regulated market.

iXbrlTagged.description: True when IFRS consolidated statements are marked up with Inline XBRL (iXBRL) tags from the ESEF taxonomy. Required only for listed issuers.

detailTaggedPrimary.description: True when the primary financial statements are tagged in detail at individual-value level (EU ESEF). Required only for listed issuers.

listedOnRegulatedMarket.description: True when the issuer's securities are admitted to trading on an EU regulated market, bringing the statements into ESEF scope.

fecEntries.description: FR Fichier des Écritures Comptables (FEC) accounting entries underlying the statements. Each entry shall be balanced (total debit equals total credit).

debit.description: Total debit of the balanced entry.

credit.description: Total credit of the balanced entry.
